Exact edit action: Use the supplied approved image as the exact identity. Direct proof review: the word clean stripped too much characteristic Rust and Ink wear from the intact baseline. Flint also lost its rear-bed cross-brace. Preserve the exact original rough ink strokes, worn pigment, rust, bone structural patches and every attachment. Intact means roadworthy, NOT cleaned, repainted, factory-new, smooth plastic or 3D shaded. Keep the full original material texture and structural fittings.
